annotations.text:
Ventic Admin Panel — five screens covering the feature set in docs/handwritten/admin-panel.md.
Chrome is lifted from the live site: src/styles/global.css tokens, the AgentPanel gauge/stat blocks, the Matrix check/cross cells, and the real Logo.astro mark.

All names, nodes, quotas and figures are sample data for layout. Model names, node hardware and component versions come from the handwritten docs; tenant and user identities are invented — swap them before this goes in front of anyone.
